card.name: Dosing and multiple-product instructions
card.fires_on: Words in dosing directions just before a timing or spacing detail, such as 'per day', 'more than one' or 'is being used' in advice about using several eye drops or injections together.

modes.label: More than one product
modes.description: The word 'one' or the verb after it in 'if more than one topical ophthalmic product is used'.
modes.example: If more than<< one>> topical ophthalmic product is to be

modes.label: Per-day dose rates
modes.description: The word 'day' after 'mg/kg per' or 'mg per' in dose amounts.
modes.example: 1,000 mg per<< day>> for patients less than 75 kg

modes.label: Verb before spacing
modes.description: A verb like 'be', 'used' or 'administered' just before a time-apart instruction.
modes.example: they should be<< administered>> at least five (5) minutes apart

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward words like 'multiple' and 'plural', which fit text about several doses or products.
card.plain: It fires in dosing directions about using more than one product or giving doses at set intervals.
